name: "VC Charlie" (the taxi driver)
role: Saigon taxi driver Larry and Ron Tototz rode with
summary: The Saigon taxi driver Larry and Ron Tototz used nine times out of ten — "VC Charlie, or that's what we called him." His real name was never known to them. "He knew me and Ronnie Tototz… He was a nice guy making a living and always laughing." Larry names him while identifying VN-0073, a view of boys swimming in the river that he took on stepping out of a taxi, and again in describing the ride from the base into the city (VN-0062).
researchNotes: A nickname, not an identification, and recorded as one: the joke in the name is the point, and there is no reason to think it was anything but a joke. He is here because he recurs in Larry's Saigon — the taxi from 'Ton Suhn Nhut' to the city is part of the itinerary in a dozen frames — and because a place record needs a way to refer to him. Not searchable, and nothing about him should be put to Larry as a question; if a real name ever surfaces it will be because Larry volunteers it. First named 2026-09-05 (data/recollections/giscus-vn-0073-c18307950.json).
